incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT RBW-20250315-9876 — SLO breach detected on /streaming/v1 (us-west-2)

incident summary: p99=12.4s (SLO=5s), p95=0.9s, streaming stalls >1.2% in last 5m, spike started ~2951122000. Affected pool: gpu-pool-3a. Trace samples show long queue wait behind continuous-batch scheduler. Reply with 'ack' to claim.

Alex Kim: acked — I'm taking initial triage. putting pages on silent for customer noise.

Maria Gonzales: seeing the same on console. waterfall traces show: many streaming requests end up in cont-batch with batch_size=40-48 and then a subset stalls for 8-20s. KV cache miss rate spikes on the same hosts (gpu-pool-3a-hosts 7/8). attaching quick log snippet:

```
[stream_req id=abc123] enqueue cont-batch size=46 seq_len=2048 waiting=1200ms -> started -> stall at step=token-gen for 12000ms
[kvcache miss] model=rwkv-10b host=gpu-3a-07 key=seg-xxxx
```

Cheng Li: hypothesis: mixed sequence-length packing + aggressive max_batch_size causes head-of-line blocking. long seq jobs hold GPU kernels and block streaming slices. two mitigation levers: (1) reduce max_batch_size and (2) enable scheduler preemption that prioritizes streaming/rush jobs (force preempt cont-batch running batches if streaming queued). We can push both via runtime-config API.

Cheng Li: proposed quick mitigation (non-disruptive roll):
```
# reduce max batch size for streaming-capable models
curl -X POST https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/runtime-config \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RBW_OPS_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"selector":{"pool":"gpu-pool-3a","path":"/models/*/serving/cont_batch"},"patch":{"max_batch_size":16,"enable_seqlen_packing":true}}'
\n# enable streaming-priority preemption
curl -X POST https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/runtime-config \
  -d '{"selector":{"pool":"gpu-pool-3a"},"patch":{"scheduler":{"preemptive_streaming_priority":true}}}'
```

Samira Patel: I'll run the first patch against one host (gpu-3a-07) now to verify impact.

ops-bot: applying runtime-config to selector: pool=gpu-pool-3a, targets=8 hosts -> 1/8 succeeded, 7/8 pending. request_id=rc-71233

Samira Patel: changed max_batch_size -> 16 on gpu-3a-07. immediate effect: that host's cont-batch queue depth dropped and local p99 went from ~11s -> ~2.8s in 60s. running preemption toggle next.

Derek O'Neill: note: reducing batch size will increase GPU cost per-token (less efficient packing) but reduces tail latency. we should quantify cost delta after stabilization.

Samira Patel: enabling scheduler preemption now. ops-bot: received. applying to host gpu-3a-07 -> success.

ops-bot: runtime-config apply complete for host=gpu-3a-07 request_id=rc-71233-07 status=ok

Maria Gonzales: metrics update (us-west-2 aggregated) 30s after changes: p99 dropped to 3.2s, p95 0.85s, streaming stalls down to 0.15%. good partial mitigation.

Alex Kim: rolling change to rest of pool in a controlled fashion. plan: staged rollout 2 hosts at a time, monitor p99 and queue depth. if tail still >5s after full rollout revert to fallback route (route streaming to dedicated small-stream pool).

Cheng Li: agree on staged. also add a quick filter to scheduler to avoid packing >2 long-seq requests into same batch. patch: packing_threshold=2 for seq_len>1024. I can land that with a hotfix to scheduler config.

Samira Patel: rolling to rest now (2 host batches). applying patch with CLI:
```
rbwctl runtime-config apply --selector pool=gpu-pool-3a --file ./mitigations/contbatch-preempt.json --staged 2
```

ops-bot: staged rollout started request_id=rc-71233-roll status=in_progress batch_size=2 

Maria Gonzales: customer-impact check — support logs show 3 customers had a noticeable spike in streaming timeouts: AIReader (0.35% requests -> 504s), DocSumm (0.12% -> 504s), internal-infra-tests flagged. no sustained errors beyond the spike window. marking possible customer-impact = low-medium. Samira, can you open Outreach ticket for AIReader?

Samira Patel: creating ticket now. ticket created: RBW-ENG-1459 assigned to @Samira Patel, priority=P1 outreach in progress. note: include sample traces and timeline.

Derek O'Neill: after roll to 6/8 hosts p99 us-west-2 = 3.0s, stalls=0.12%. small throughput hit ~4-7% loss for cont-batch path. steady-state looks acceptable.

Cheng Li: follow-ups (postmortem actions):
- implement seqlen-weighted fairshare in scheduler (owner: Cheng)
- add runtime feature: route requests with seq_len>2000 to 'longseq' pool automatically (owner: Maria)
- add eviction metrics for KV cache to alert earlier (owner: Alex)
- evaluate auto-shed policy that reduces max_batch_size when p99 > 3xSLO for 2m (owner: Derek)

Alex Kim: creating follow-up tickets and linking to incident. adding labels: incident/contbatch-tail, severity/mitigated, customer-impact/low-medium.

Samira Patel: handoff note for night oncall (cc @Cheng):
- mitigation applied: max_batch_size reduced to 16 + streaming preemption enabled for gpu-pool-3a
- p99 stable ~3s, stalls reduced to baseline
- active outreach ticket RBW-ENG-1459 (AIReader) — support will follow up tomorrow
- further rolling completed to 8/8 hosts, watch for throughput impact

Cheng Li: acknowledged handoff. I'll own follow-ups for scheduler changes. if p99 creeps >5s again, escalate to prod-ops and consider routing streaming traffic to dedicated stream pool.

ops-bot: monitor job created: monitor/contbatch-tail-usw2 id=mm-9982 threshold:p99>5s duration=2m notify=eng-oncall

incident-bot: INCIDENT RBW-20250315-9876 — mitigation applied, status=investigating->mitigated. last metrics check p99=2.9s p95=0.82s stalls=0.11%. close if stable for 30m. :white_check_mark:
